purpose: Explicitly easier, strong-signal synthetic scenario for the retention prototype; not evidence of real FPT accuracy.
simulator_changes: Rare, strongly observable adverse episodes precede outcomes; histories are not generated conditional on churn labels.
All scheduled payments and ticket closures have finite dates, censored at report cutoff.
Label hazard explicitly made more separable to meet a demo goal; AUC changes versus v3 reflect a different simulated task.
One locked configuration and seed; no seed/noise search based on holdout scores.
evaluation: Train development IDs on Jan-Jun snapshots, validate development IDs July, test held-out IDs August snapshot only (September outcome). September snapshot inference October Unknown.
